caption:
Chicken Sausage Maggi 
this chicken sausage maggi is one we enjoyed many sunday mornings at Uncle’s right next to our hostel! 
recreating the perfect combination of great food with nostalgia

Nutrition: 
C: 74 | F: 23 | P: 18
Calories: 570 per serve 
Serves 2

Ingredients
3 bundles of maggi noodles
1 tsp olive oil 
5 garlic cloves, minced
1 onion, sliced
1/2 capsicum, thinly sliced
150 grams chicken sausage
reserve water from cooking the maggi 

you can also add any other veges you want!!!!

This recipe is pretty self explanatory and if you have any doubts, drop a comment :) 

also, ive recently started cooking in stainless steel more and not enjoying it at all!!! if you have any tips at all, share them PLEASE :D
